title: GreenVedaa  Nutrela Green Plant Protein
desc: Packed with 100% plant protein, GreenVedaa  Nutrela Green Plant Protein combines the goodness of natural ingredients to support muscle growth, recovery, and overall wellness. It’s enriched with vitamins, minerals, and digestive enzymes for better absorption.
benefits: Easy to digest with added enzymes
directions: Mix 1 scoop (approx. 30g) with 200–250 ml of water or milk. Shake or stir well before consuming. Best taken post-workout or as recommended by a nutritionist.
